title: Check display settings
body: The researcher can check the display or continue with the current settings. Continuing is possible in either fullscreen or windowed mode.
setup: Use 1920 × 1080 pixels, 100% display scaling and browser zoom, and fullscreen on the intended display. Ctrl + 0 resets browser zoom.
ready: The display matches the intended settings again. The researcher can confirm that you may continue.
waiting: The intended display settings could not yet be confirmed.
fullscreen_failed: Fullscreen could not be opened. Please use the browser's fullscreen option.
timers: Any running time limits still apply.
calibration_interrupted: The display changed during calibration. Please repeat calibration.
continue_unverified_notice: Continuing with the current display preserves answers and time limits. Unverified gaze data will not be used for AOI analysis. This permission lasts until the page is reloaded or you sign out.

reasons.checking_display: The display must remain stable briefly before it can be confirmed.
reasons.screen_resolution: The reported screen resolution does not match 1920 × 1080 pixels.
reasons.window_size: The reported browser area does not match 1920 × 1080 pixels.
reasons.window_position: The browser reports a different window position.
reasons.display_scale: The reported display scaling or browser zoom does not match 100%.
reasons.viewport_zoom: The visible page area is zoomed or shifted.
reasons.window_focus: The study window is not in the foreground.
reasons.native_measurement: The Windows bridge must confirm the current study page position.

native_setup: The Windows bridge measures the study page’s position on the display directly. Fullscreen and windowed mode are supported. Keep the study page in the foreground on the eye tracker’s display.
native_ready: The study page’s position has been measured. The researcher can confirm gaze mapping. Later window-size changes will be measured automatically.
mapping_waiting: AOI mapping is waiting for a valid display measurement.
